Narwhal or whale ivory model of Nenets village with trees, a chum tent, reindeer, human figures, etc. mounted on a rectangular platform. Depicts scenes from life of harnessing reindeer, childbirth and a bear hunt. Inaccuracies in the harness, ceremonies involving acts of kneeling and raised hands draw on stereotypical views of Nenets' culture and was created by a non-Indigenous carver, possibly as part of the Tobol'sk workshops
